# Sample Customer Help Policy

**Document ID:** generated by application at upload time\
**Version:** 1.0\
**Purpose:** Synthetic policy document for demonstrating grounded
document Q&A. All contact details and policy terms are fictional test
data.

## Returns and Refunds

Eligible physical items may be returned within **30 days of delivery**.
Items must be in their original condition with included accessories.
Final-sale items, personalized items, and opened digital-download codes
are not eligible for return, except where applicable law requires
otherwise.

After the returned item is received and inspected, the refund is
initiated within **5 business days**. A bank or payment provider may
take additional time to post the refund. Original shipping charges are
not refunded unless the return is due to an error by the seller or
applicable law requires a refund.

## Damaged or Incorrect Items

Customers should report a damaged or incorrect item within **48 hours of
delivery**. The report should include the order number, a description of
the issue, and clear photos of the item and packaging. Support may
request additional information before arranging a replacement or refund.

Customers should retain the item and packaging until support provides
instructions. Do not discard the packaging before the claim is reviewed.

## Shipping and Delivery

Standard domestic shipping usually arrives within **3--5 business days
after dispatch**. Delivery estimates are not guarantees and may be
affected by weather, carrier delays, holidays, or remote delivery areas.

A tracking number may be created before the carrier performs its first
scan. Tracking can take up to **24 hours after dispatch** to show the
first scan.

If the delivery address is incorrect after dispatch, the customer should
contact support immediately. An address change is not guaranteed after
dispatch. If a parcel is already with the carrier, the carrier may not
allow redirection.

## Missing Parcels

Customers should contact support if tracking has not updated for **5
business days** or if the estimated delivery date has passed by **2
business days**. Support will review the carrier status and advise on
next steps. A parcel marked delivered but not received should be
reported as soon as possible.

## Contact and Support

Customers can contact the sample support team at
**support@example.test**. When a request concerns an order, include the
order number. Never send a password, one-time password, or full
payment-card number by email or chat.

Support hours for this fictional policy are Monday through Friday,
09:00--17:00 Nepal Time, excluding public holidays. Messages received
outside those hours are handled on the next business day.

## Billing and Payments

The sample checkout supports credit/debit cards and the local wallet
option shown at checkout. The payment methods shown at the time of
purchase are authoritative; availability can vary by region.

For a billing issue, provide the order number, a description of the
discrepancy, and the transaction date. Never include a full payment-card
number or security code in a support request.

## Account and Security

If a customer suspects unauthorized account access, they should change
their password from the official account page and contact support
promptly. Support will never ask for a password or one-time password.

Use a unique password and do not share account credentials. Messages
claiming to be support should be treated cautiously if they request
credentials or payment secrets.

## Warranty

Eligible hardware accessories have a **12-month limited warranty from
delivery**, subject to the product's stated exclusions. Proof of
purchase may be required.

The limited warranty does not cover accidental liquid damage,
unauthorized modifications, normal cosmetic wear, or damage caused by
misuse. If a product appears defective, contact support with the order
number and a description of the issue before attempting a repair.

## Privacy and Document Use

This document is fictional demonstration content. It does not define
real legal rights or actual company policy. The assistant should answer
questions only when the retrieved text supports the answer. If this
document does not contain the requested fact, the correct response is
that the information is not available in the provided document.
